purpose: S5/S6最终Hasselblad完整29项默认8路顺序after，同时作为S8并发与分片档位数据。

world_sessions.identity: Python metrics nodeid + canonical metrics.parent，校验同目录Node的session_id/node_pid一致；只取primary pytest树，真实路径去重，排除current与.local归档副本。
world_sessions.scope: counts只覆盖18个PhotoWorld，独立one-shot预设/上传另列；Node CPU只当前会话Node，不含Chrome或安装CLI。

one_shot_client_commands.scope: 真实已保存独立Node命令记录；subprocess超时可能未生成命令record，因此失败档该count不表示所有启动尝试。另列真实photo输入/回执及原pytest超时trace，不把静态推算的Application/browser次数混入显式world recorder。

resource_scope: Metadata git rev-parse/status children finish before children_before and start time. The measured interval has exactly one runner child; CPU/I/O deltas exclude prior metadata usage. RUSAGE_CHILDREN contains waited descendant usage propagated by child reaping. Raw ru_maxrss is the lifetime maximum single descendant process (including prior metadata git); children_before retains its prior value. It is not concurrent tree memory. inblock/oublock are raw kernel block-operation counts, not bytes. No complete per-process CPU/I/O sample or device-throughput claim.
browser_observation_scope: resource.json的legacy observed_browser_roots_count仅表示符合executable/argv过滤的唯一PID/start_ticks观察，可能漏采或误分类；不是browser launch/session精确数或下界，不替代显式world生命周期。
comparison_limits: before含1个尚未capture的正常链失败；总wall仅作各轮事实，同28完整pass身份的phase另列，不将29全pass后的新增工作当作退化。
S5生命周期和S6预设分区一起实施；不声称各自独立性能百分比。
默认root-shards随jobs改变，6/8同时包含并发与额外会话准备成本；各轮无并行其他bench，结果为单次采样。
阶段耗时含共享fixture和等待，准备归属变化会影响单项setup；不能逐行差直接当操作收益。
